meta.notes: SAAMI: MAP values are read from the Velocity & Pressure Data tables (printed as psi/100 and CUP/100; multiplied by 100 here). saamiMapPsi = transducer (piezo) MAP; saamiMapCup = copper crusher MAP (CUP, not psi). Dimensions (bullet/bore/groove diameter, max case length, max COAL, twist) are read from the cartridge & chamber drawings by pairing each inch value with its millimetre twin (inch*25.4 == mm within rounding); values failing plausibility gates were dropped (null) and the reason is in the record notes. Bullet diameter = maximum bullet diameter (minus tolerance shown in saami.bulletDiameterVariantsIn). Case length = maximum case length (drawing shows max with minus tolerance). saamiTwist = inches per turn as printed on the drawing, direction in saamiTwistDirection. transducerLocation.saamiFromBreechFaceIn is the breech-face-to-transducer-centreline dimension from the SAAMI V&P test barrel drawing. C.I.P.: Pmax, PK, PE, EE and the pressure-take location M come from the public TDCC list (bobp.cip-bobp.org/en/tdcc_public); L3 (max case length), L6 (max cartridge length), G1 (projectile diameter), F (barrel field/bore diameter) and Z (groove diameter) come from the EN TDCC sheets (mm). Where a cartridge has SAAMI dimensions, the inch fields hold the SAAMI value; C.I.P. values that differ beyond rounding (>0.0015 in for diameters, >0.02 in for lengths) are listed in conflicts. Where only C.I.P. gives a dimension, the inch field is mm/25.4 and the mm value is kept in <field>Mm. SAAMI and C.I.P. entries were merged only on an exact (or word-normalised) name match whose dimensions agree; see meta.linking. trimLengthIn is null throughout: no trim-to length appears in the parsed SAAMI drawings or C.I.P. sheets. primerSize is null throughout: the parsed documents do not assign a primer size per cartridge (SAAMI only shows generic primer/pocket drawings). cipPmaxBar is C.I.P. maximum (average) pressure Pmax in bar, measured per C.I.P. method (sheet "Method", usually Transducer); it is not directly comparable to SAAMI MAP.
